about: Legitimate uses of avoid words for tools/lint-terms.mjs (npm run lint:terms). uiOnly: words matched only in UI strings although longer than two characters. docsToo: short words matched in docs prose too. allow: {file (glob), pattern (regex: the hit must lie inside its match) or line (substring of the line), term, reason, keep? (keep even when nothing matches now)}. noPairs: term ids skipped by the ja↔en pair check (their ja word is too generic for substring pairing, e.g. 本 in 2 本 and 日本語). aiDocsToo: avoid words also matched in the AI-instruction docs (docs/authoring-with-llms*), which otherwise use the spec's words and are not checked. avoidPatterns: {term, lang, label, pattern (regex), docsToo?}: avoid words that need a pattern, such as 版 alone for a version (compounds like 正式版 are excluded by the pattern).

avoidPatterns.label: 版（単独）
avoidPatterns.pattern: (?<!正式|配信|最新|日本語|英語|ブラウザ|オフライン|コマンド|ベータ|再生専用|試用|出|初|再|改|訂)版(?![権画元面木])
avoidPatterns.reason: Owner 2026-11-13: 版 alone is unclear; use バージョン. Compounds stay. 試用版 is in avoid as a word.

avoidPatterns.label: 札
avoidPatterns.reason: Owner 2026-11-15: 札 is the main cause of unclear sentences; say card, tile, label or tooltip by meaning (#223).

avoidPatterns.label: 帯
avoidPatterns.pattern: (?<![時間地世携包熱声附連一温寒])帯(?!グラフ|域|び|びる)
avoidPatterns.reason: Owner 2026-11-15: 帯 → bar, status bar, 説明欄, or 期間 (timeline) by meaning (#223). 帯グラフ stays.

avoidPatterns.label: 板（パネル）
avoidPatterns.reason: Owner 2026-11-15: 板 → パネル (#223). 黒板・掲示板 stay.
